comment: The MODE CV jacks do not add to the switches, they assign to them: params[PARAM_ADDER_MODE + ch].value is set to -1, 0 or 1 at src/htAdder.cpp:154-159. The switch therefore moves on the panel and keeps the position the CV last wrote once the cable is removed. The middle position needs an exact 0.0f, which a continuous CV will rarely hit. The first row is not like the other four: at :173 its CV is assigned to the total rather than added, and it is assigned whether or not the switch is at 0, so setting that switch to 0 does not remove the row. All ten jacks are read through Port::value, which is channel 0 of a polyphonic cable.
